name: Home Feed
description: Main PulseSoc social feed for posts, discovery, reactions, comments, creators, and quick app navigation.
user_help: Tap Home in the bottom navigation and scroll the feed.

name: Reels
description: Immersive vertical video and Live watching surface.
user_help: Tap Reels or tap Join Live anywhere to open that Live inside Reels.

name: Create Status
description: Create short-lived photo, video, text, or music Status posts.
user_help: Tap Create, choose Status, add media or music, choose privacy, then post.

name: Messenger
description: Conversation inbox for direct chats, groups, Pulse AI, media messages, voice messages, and Pulses.
user_help: Tap Messages, then choose a conversation or Pulse AI.

name: Audio Pulses
description: Start a voice connection from a Messenger conversation.
user_help: Open a conversation and tap the phone icon.

name: Video Pulses
description: Start a video connection from a Messenger conversation.
user_help: Open a conversation and tap the video icon.

name: Pulse AI
description: PulseSoc's assistant for platform help, feature guidance, safety education, and current information when web search is needed.
user_help: Open Messenger and tap the Pulse AI conversation.

name: PulseSoc Music
description: Music identity, trending songs, Status soundtracks, and creator audio discovery.
user_help: Use the music controls in Status or music discovery surfaces.

name: Notification Center
description: In-app notifications, unread counts, deep links, and read state.
user_help: Tap the notification bell to view and manage notifications.

name: Push Notifications
description: Device/browser push delivery for messages, comments, calls, crypto alerts, security alerts, and other eligible events.
user_help: Enable notifications after PulseSoc explains the value, then manage channels in settings.

name: Manage My Alerts
description: Manage every crypto alert that can fire for the user.
user_help: Open Crypto Command Center, then Manage My Alerts.

name: Galaxy Intelligence Center
description: Subscribe to Intelligence Streams, set confidence thresholds, use digest modes, and provide feedback.
user_help: Open Galaxy Intelligence Center and choose streams such as Crypto Pulse, Security Pulse, or World Pulse.

name: Conversation Control Center
description: Control settings for a Messenger conversation.
user_help: Open a conversation, tap More, then choose Conversation Control Center.

name: Notification Privacy
description: Manage lock-screen previews, muted conversations, quiet hours, and channel preferences.
user_help: Open settings or a conversation control center and adjust notification/privacy toggles.

name: Account Security
description: Protect account access, sessions, password resets, devices, and security alerts.
user_help: Use a strong password, enable available protections, review sessions, and respond to security alerts.

name: Account Recovery
description: Official flows for resetting password or recovering access.
user_help: Use Forgot Password from the official PulseSoc login page.

name: Creator Tools
description: Creator insights, recommendations, verification, and Premium creator workflows.
user_help: Open Profile or Creator surfaces to access creator tools.

name: Premium / Founder Access
description: Premium identity, creator, profile, and advanced platform enhancements.
user_help: Open Premium to review benefits and billing options.

name: Verification Badges
description: Verification surfaces for trusted or approved accounts.
user_help: Use the verification center if eligible.

name: PulseSoc Live
description: PulseSoc Live is watched only inside Reels.
user_help: Tap Join Live anywhere or open Reels to encounter Live streams.

name: Search
description: Find people, rooms, posts, conversations, and relevant PulseSoc surfaces.
user_help: Use the search field and type a name, topic, room, or conversation.

name: Profile
description: Identity, avatar, creator information, posts, and profile preferences.
user_help: Tap Profile in the bottom navigation.

name: Download and Share PulseSoc
description: Official download and sharing actions use polished PulseSoc buttons instead of raw links.
user_help: Use Download PulseSoc, Open PulseSoc, Share PulseSoc, Invite Friends, or Join the Galaxy buttons when they appear. Pulse AI can guide users to the official App Store page without dumping the raw link unless asked.
